Command.Name: SetTCP_ActiveModule
Command.FPOperation: Selects the active communication module - LAN or WiFi. This option can be set only if the device has both modules at the same time. To apply use - SaveNetworkSettings()

Arg.Name: OptionUsedModule
Arg.Desc: 1 symbol with value: - '1' - LAN module - '2' - WiFi module
